"''It is our only hope.|A Kaliida Shoals clone medic and Nala Se|audio=OurOnlyHope-SoM.flac|{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}}} '''Nala Se''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the conflict, Se worked out of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] secret [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] intended to facilitate the rehabilitation of wounded [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who had recently begun to attack Republic forces with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], was directed by the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to destroy the Kaliida Shoals Center, as it was the only medical facility for the treatment of injured [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. Grievous' attack on the [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] was anticipated by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who made preparations for a strike against the ''Malevolence'' while Se began the evacuation of Kaliida Shoals. To her dismay, she was unable to remove many clones from the center. Even with the arrival of the ''Malevolence'', Se refused to flee the station and leave her patients behind. However, Skywalker and the Republic's [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] arrived and [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|engaged]] the ''Malevolence'', which was forced to retreat before it could damage the station. Nala Se would later be transferred to a [[Ord Cestus medical station/Legends|medical station]] near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]], where she would serve alongside [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]. In the aftermath of a [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|second battle]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], the station was designated to be the source of much-needed medical supplies for General [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] forces on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. However, the clones aboard the [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]] [[TB-73/Legends|TB-73]], which was to retrieve the supplies, had been infected by [[Brain worm/Legends|mind-controlling parasites]] from the Geonosian battlefront. Upon emerging from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the out-of-control [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ran the risk of either colliding with the medical station or docking to spread the disease, but was stopped due to the efforts of Fisto and [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawans]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]. Throughout the rest of the war, Doctor Se was also one of the few individuals that knew about [[Order 66/Legends|Clone Protocol 66]], a secret directive encoded into the control chip of every clone in the Republic's [[Republic Military/Legends|military]]. Believing the chips acted as a safeguard against renegade [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Nala Se went to great lengths to preserve the secrecy of Protocol 66 throughout the war, and once Order 66 was issued by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], every clone turned against their fellow Jedi [[Jedi General/Legends|Generals]] and [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commanders]], and thus bringing the start of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. After the Republic was transformed into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Se continued her service and worked on the creation of [[clone stormtrooper]]s. ==Biography== ===Overseeing Kaliida Shoals=== ====Evacuation==== {{Quote|Even if we had the transports, it is not possible to evacuate all of our wounded in time.''"
"''You must try. You won't stand a chance against that battleship.|Nala Se and Admiral Wullf Yularen|audio=YouMustTry-SoM.flac|}} Nala Se was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] who lived prior to the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Se served the Republic as the [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]].{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}} Kaliida Shoals had been purchased by the Republic at the beginning of the war, and was adapted to function as a secret facility in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] that worked to rehabilitate injured [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that had been bred on Se's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. As the only facility functioning in such a capacity, Kaliida Shoals was vital to the Republic's war effort. [[File:NalaSeKenobiYularenConferenceCall-RM.png|thumb|left|300px|Nala Se communicates with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Yularen]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].]] In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' the Republic learned of a new Confederate [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. A [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class cruiser]], the ''Malevolence'' was outfitted with two large [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. The ion waves it fired were capable of disabling entire [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]], leaving them vulnerable to the hundreds of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries on the ship's hull. Following the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} [[Battle of the Ryndellia system/Legends|attack]] on a Republic medical convoy in the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]], the ship's commander, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], was informed by the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], of the location of the Kaliida Shoals [[Space station/Legends|station]]. Dooku claimed that the destruction of Kaliida Shoals would leave the Republic without a treatment facility for injured [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], greatly hindering the Republic's war effort. While the ''Malevolence'' headed toward Se's [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] prepared an attack on the battleship. After receiving word of the battle at [[Ryndellia/Legends|Ryndellia]], Skywalker surmised that Grievous's next target would be Kaliida Shoals, due to its proximity to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] close to the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]]. Skywalker ordered [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] to contact Nala Se and warn her of the impending danger while he and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], led the Republic's [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] in a mission to intercept and destroy the ''Malevolence''. In the command tower of the Kaliida Shoals medcenter, Se was contacted by Yularen via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], who warned her of the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} approach and urged her to begin evacuating the station. Se knew that an evacuation of Kaliida Shoals, which was treating over 60,000 clones, would not proceed quickly enough to remove all of the wounded from harm's path. Se and Yularen's communication was joined by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had recently learned of the impending attack. Kenobi had contacted the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|people of Naboo]] to request ships to assist in the evacuation, and was heading to Kaliida Shoals himself in the [[Negotiator/Legends|''Negotiator'']], his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. After the communication was terminated, Se's [[Unidentified clone chief medic/Legends|clone medical aide]] questioned whether or not she believed in the Republic's ability to defeat the ''Malevolence'', to which she replied that it was their only hope. Although the ''Malevolence'' began its journey to the medical station, it was forced to chart a lengthy course around the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]]. This, along with Skywalker's use of the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run shortcut]], allowed the Republic forces the possibility of intercepting Grievous before his attack. As both groups raced toward Kaliida Shoals, Se's evacuation proceeded slowly. She ordered that priority be given to patients in stable condition, while more critically injured [[Troop/Legends|troopers]] would have to wait for transport off station. Se conceded to a clone medic who was aiding in the evacuation that the patients confined to [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]] would be unmovable, and so focus should remain on those who could be safely transported. ====Arrival of the ''Malevolence''==== {{Quote|It looks as though Skywalker has failed. He's lost almost half his ships. We should go, Madame.''"
"''I will stay.|Nala Se's clone aide and Nala Se|audio=IWillStay-SoM.flac|}} [[File:Lets_gtfo.png|thumb|right|270px|Nala Se and her medical aide, as the ''Malevolence'' targets Kaliida Shoals.]] By the time the ''Malevolence'' jumped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] near the station, Se's efforts had only yielded a fifty percent evacuation. As the battleship approached the Kaliida Shoals medcenter, several [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigates]] that were assisting in the evacuation attempted to flee; however, they were quickly disabled by the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} ion cannons. As Grievous opened fire on them, Skywalker's [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] arrived and [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|engaged]] the ''Malevolence''. During the fighting, nearly half of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] force was destroyed. Monitoring the battle from the medcenter, Se's clone aide encouraged her to escape the station, as the Republic's chances of victory were slim. Se refused, and remained on station even as it was targeted by the ''Malevolence''{{'s}} ion cannons. The station was saved, however, as Skywalker and his squadron were able to damage the [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] starboard cannon, resulting in an overload of the weapon. From the Kaliida Shoals command center, Se watched as an explosion caused by the overload crippled the Confederate [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. Shortly thereafter, Master Kenobi arrived with three [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] to chase the ''Malevolence'' as it fled from the medical station. Before returning to battle, Skywalker and Tano landed on the Kaliida Shoals Medical Center. The two Jedi met with Se, who thanked them for their efforts and reminded them of the importance of the lives they saved. Skywalker agreed with her; however, he also told Se that he regretted the lives lost during the battle. After the Jedi Knight left to return to the engagement against the ''Malevolence'', Se commented to Tano on her master's curious demeanor for a Jedi. ===Continued threats=== {{Quote|Warn all medical hazard crews that I don't want anyone boarding that ship until the parasites are contained.|Kit Fisto, to Nala Se and her clone medics|{{TCW|Brain Invaders}}}} Sometime during the Clone Wars, the infamous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] came under the employ of Count Dooku, who wished for the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] to travel to the Kaliida Shoals Medical Center and infect the troopers there with a virus that would ultimately cripple the entirety of the Grand Army. Bane was incarcerated by Republic officials before he could accomplish his mission, but soon escaped custody and moved to finish the job. He was pursued across several [[Planet/Legends|planets]] by a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]], who eventually learned that Bane was headed for the Kaliida Shoals Center. The Jedi Knight traveled to the medical station and met with Nala Se, hoping the Kaminoan would have information regarding Bane's mission. Although Dooku's plot was revealed and Bane was defeated, the Jedi was too late to prevent him from infecting the trooper's bacta tanks with the virus. Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] oversaw the damage control, and dispatched [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healers]] to the Kaliida Shoals Medical Center to stop the spread of the virus.{{TCWA|Card Commander}} Nala Se was later transferred off of Kaliida Shoals to serve on a [[Ord Cestus medical station/Legends|medical station]] near the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]]. There, Se served under [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] alongside a number of clone medical officers. During the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|second battle]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], the Ord Cestus medical station was selected to be the source of medical supplies for [[General/Legends|General]] Mace Windu and his forces on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. The much-needed supplies were to be picked up by the ''Pelta''-class frigate designated [[TB-73/Legends|TB-73]] that was returning from duty on the embattled Geonosis.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode208.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Brain Invaders}} Jedi Padawans Ahsoka Tano and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] were placed in charge of the supply run and were escorted by the Grand Army's [[Tango Company/Legends|Tango Company]]. Before departing Geonosis, Tango Company was infected by [[Brain worm/Legends|parasitic, mind-controlling worms]] that were native to the planet. The infected clones betrayed their Jedi commanders and hijacked the vessel, but were defeated by Tano and Offee with the help of General Skywalker. Despite this, Offee was also infected by the worms and during a scuffle between the two Padawans on the frigate's bridge, the vessel's controls were damaged. The out-of-control frigate was prevented from colliding with the station and killing Se and everyone on board by a pair of [[Republic tugboat/Legends|tug ships]] which safely guided it in to dock. ===Post-Clone Wars=== By the end of the Clone Wars, Nala Se was still working on the creation of [[clone stormtrooper]]s for the newly created [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] from the [[Declaration of a New Order|restructuring]] of the Galactic Republic. She proceeded to file a report to upcoming commanders in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] that clone troopers made by them are indeed the best, and also made note of the incidents on Christophsis and Ringo Vinda. Her report was later included in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', the official field manual for Commanders in the Imperial Military. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|General Skywalker, I wanted to thank you for your valiant effort today. Do not take the lives you saved lightly.|Nala Se, to Anakin Skywalker|audio=NalaSeThankYou-SoM.flac|}} [[File:Nala_and_Bacta.png|thumb|left|250px|Nala Se cared greatly for the clones under her care.]] Contrary to the common demeanor of Kaminoans, Nala Se cared deeply for the clones under her care. As administrator of the Kaliida Shoals medcenter, Se led the only known facility that functioned to treat the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] injured clone troopers. After learning of Grievous' plans to destroy Kaliida Shoals, Se made a valiant attempt to evacuate the injured clone troopers and transport them out of harm's way; however, the Kaminoan recognized that it would be impossible to evacuate the entire facility. Over the course of the evacuation, Se made sure to prioritize the order of evacuation, ensuring that the patients in stable conditions were moved first. Kaliida Shoals contained many troopers who required bacta tanks for rehabilitation, and these troopers were unable to be moved from the station; subsequently, they were among those who remained on station when the ''Malevolence'' arrived. Se refused to leave these troopers, even as the medcenter was targeted by the battleship's massive ion cannons. During Grievous's retreat, Se expressed her gratitude to Skywalker for his actions. Nala Se had a masterful knowledge of cloning techniques and had an innate talent for medical practices. She wore specialized equipment that allowed her to quickly access serum samples she was carrying on her belt, and utilized boots built specifically for the slender build of a Kaminoan foot. ==Behind the scenes== Nala Se's first appearance was in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]" on [[Cartoon Network]]. In the episode, Nala Se is voiced by [[Gwendoline Yeo]], who would return to the series to voice several characters, including the [[Bettie-Bot VJ]] in "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]"{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}} and [[Peppi Bow]] in "[[Blue Shadow Virus (episode)|Blue Shadow Virus]]."{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode017.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Blue Shadow Virus}} She would later appear in the eighth episode of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]], entitled "[[Brain Invaders]]." Although she has no lines in the episode and is not identified, the "Brain Invaders" [http://www.starwars.com/theclonewars/guide/episode208.html episode guide] indicates that the script identifies the Kaminoan on the Ord Cestus medical station as Nala Se. ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'' included the character "Nala Shan"—a Kaminoan administrator of the Kaliida Shoals MedCenter. Despite the obvious similarities between Shan and Se, Nala Shan's name has yet to be confirmed as either a typo or a deliberately created new character, and thus the novel currently stands as only a possible appearance of Se. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Nala Se|imagecat=Images of Nala Se}} *{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] *{{TCW|Brain Invaders}} *{{TCW|Senate Murders}} {{Flash}} *{{TCW|Conspiracy}} *{{TCW|Fugitive}} *{{TCW|Orders (episode)}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' {{1stm}} *{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a2505961cd20f84011ce7a789390007|text=Dataclip: Shadow of ''Malevolence''|na=video file}} *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}} *{{CSWECite|II||Kaliida Shoals Med Station}} *{{SWArchive|url=fans/media/womenofsw/index.html?page=3|text=The Women of ''Star Wars'': The Women of the Prequel Trilogy}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition in-game databank; as "Nalase"}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' *{{Topps|set=2009 Topps Star Wars: The Clone Wars Widevision|cardname=Attacking ''Malevolence''}} {{Po}} *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode208.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Brain Invaders}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[The Clone Wars: Planets in Peril]]'' {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]'' *{{DB|location|kaliidashoals|Kaliida Shoals Med Center}} *{{DB|character|nalase|Se, Nala}} *''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Nala Se |es=Nala Se |it=Nala Se |nl=Nala Se |pl=Nala Se |pt=Nala Se }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Se, Nala}} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Galactic Republic individuals]] [[Category:Healers and doctors]] [[Category:Kaminoans]] [[Category:Personnel of the Galactic Empire]]
